europe_now.title: Mass Arrests and Widespread Destruction Follow Unrest Across France
europe_now.summary: Nationwide unrest in France has resulted in damage to approximately 1,500 businesses and more than 1,800 arrests by law enforcement. Police also reported that one demonstrator died from cardiorespiratory arrest during protests in Paris.

sources.headline: 'Like we had a war': France left reeling after nationwide violent protests
🔴 A demonstrator died from 'cardiorespiratory arrest' during Paris protests, police say

europe_now.title: Ukrainian Drone Strike Hits Saint Petersburg Oil Refinery
europe_now.summary: A large-scale Ukrainian drone assault targeted an energy facility in Saint Petersburg, igniting an oil refinery. Authorities confirmed that the attack caused significant damage and killed at least one person.

sources.headline: Ukraine strikes oil facility in St. Petersburg as part of ‘massive’ drone attack
Ukrainian drone attack on Saint Petersburg kills one, sets refinery ablaze

top_stories.title: Nationwide Clashes and Mass Detentions Across France
top_stories.summary: Widespread demonstrations across France resulted in heavy property damage, including vandalism to around 1,500 retail stores. French authorities took more than 1,800 individuals into custody nationwide following incidents of looting, arson, and violent confrontations.

sources.headline: 'Like we had a war': France left reeling after nationwide violent protests
Live: Around 1,500 shops and retailers damaged during French protests, trade group says

top_stories.title: Ukrainian Drone Attack Strikes Russian Energy Facility
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian forces launched an extensive drone operation that struck an oil installation in Saint Petersburg. The strike ignited a blaze at the refinery and left one person dead.

sources.headline: Ukraine strikes oil facility in St. Petersburg as part of ‘massive’ drone attack

top_stories.title: Anti-Government Protests Persist in Albania
top_stories.summary: Demonstrations in Tirana reached their fifth consecutive day as participants protested against the national government. The ongoing civil unrest in the capital has intensified with continuing clashes between demonstrators and authorities.

sources.headline: Riots in Tirana enter a fifth day as Albania's anti-government protests escalate

top_stories.title: Electoral Defeat for Czech Prime Minister in Senate Vote
top_stories.summary: Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babis failed to win any seats in the latest round of elections for the upper house of parliament. The vote outcome marked a major setback for the populist leader.

sources.headline: Populist Czech PM Babis goes empty-handed in Senate elections
